decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Technical Submittal For the Lightning Protection System, dated 18th May 2015, received 24/06/2015; Proposed plan 12521 Revision A, dated 15/10/2015, received 15/10/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - All associated equipment is to be removed if no longer in operation, and any disruption to building fabric shall be made good to match its surroundings in materials, colour and texture within one month of the removal.
description: Installation of a lightning conductor system to the exterior of the building
